known_gray_zone.note: The 'impossible cost' short-circuit in allow() compares the requested cost against the limiter-wide self._burst, ignoring any per-key burst set through configure_key, so the retry_after=inf fast path can disagree with a key's actual ceiling. Arguably a pre-existing inconsistency a reviewer might flag, but it is not one of the injected defects.
